description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bills head coach Joe Brady said he does not expect the injury to Dee Alford to be of the long-term variety.
items.impact: Alford is dealing with an ankle injury. He is week-to-week for now.
items.title: Dee Alford (ankle) not expected to be out long-term

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bills head coach Joe Brady said he does not expect the injury to Ed Oliver to be of the long-term variety.
items.impact: Oliver is dealing with a knee injury. He is week-to-week for now.
items.title: Ed Oliver (knee) not expected to be out long-term

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rashod Bateman was seen practicing in a non-contact jersey Thursday.
items.impact: Bateman opened the week with a limited practice on Wednesday. He'll need to be monitored on the official injury report.
items.title: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) in non-contact jersey Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Zay Flowers was seen practicing again on Thursday.
items.impact: Wacker notes that Flowers began practicing on the side before moving into team drills. He'll be worth monitoring on the injury report.
items.title: Zay Flowers (foot) practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Drew Kendall was not seen practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Kendall will need to be monitored in practice on Friday.
items.title: Drew Kendall (knee) not seen practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Marcus Epps was not seen practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Epps will need to be monitored in practice on Friday.
items.title: Marcus Epps (groin) not seen practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tylan Wallace was not seen practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Wallace did not practice on Wednesday either. He remains off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Tylan Wallace (knee) not practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kalia Davis was not seen practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Davis was designated to return to practice on Wednesday. It is unclear if this is a scheduled absence. He'll need to be monitored in practice on Friday.
items.title: Kalia Davis (quad) not seen practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Mike Hall Jr. was not seen practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Hall also missed practice on Wednesday. He'll likely have to practice in some capacity on Friday to be able to play on Sunday.
items.title: Mike Hall Jr. (ankle) not seen practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Teven Jenkins was not seen practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Jenkins will likely have to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play this weekend.
items.title: Teven Jenkins (back) not seen practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Mason Graham did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Graham remains likely to miss a few weeks after leaving early in Week 4.
items.title: Mason Graham (MCL sprain) not practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: DJ Moore was not seen at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It is not a huge surprise that Moore begins the week missing practice. He'll need to continue to be monitored on Friday and Saturday ahead of Monday's showdown against the Rams.
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) not seen practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Mack Hollins was not seen practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: It is a second straight absence for Hollins to begin the week after his early exit last Sunday. He is likely to be sidelined in Week 5, but he'll need to be monitored in practice on Friday to make sure.
items.title: Mack Hollins (calf) not seen practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Christian Gonzalez remained absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It is a fifth straight missed practice for Gonzalez. He'll need to be monitored in practice again on Friday heading into Week 5.
items.title: Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) not practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Zack Baun was seen practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Baun was limited in practice on Wednesday. He remains in concussion protocol, but back-to-back practices to begin the week gives him a chance to be able to clear it.
items.title: Zack Baun (concussion) practices Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dallas Goedert was seen practicing again on Thursday.
items.impact: Goedert opened the week with a limited practice. He could have a chance to return on Sunday if he can practice all week. If not, a return in Week 6 becomes likely.
items.title: Dallas Goedert (knee) practices Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jonathan Greenard was not seen practicing again on Thursday.
items.impact: Greenard did not practice on Wednesday to begin the week. He'll likely have to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play on Sunday.
items.title: Jonathan Greenard (ankle) not seen practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Saquon Barkley was not seen practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Barkley remains unlikely to play this week on Sunday. Will Shipley appears likely to be the lead back against the Jaguars in London.
items.title: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) not seen practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: DeVonta Smith was seen working off to the side during practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Smith continues to trend towards missing another game on Sunday. He'll be hopeful to return in Week 6 next week.
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) works off to side in practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rhamondre Stevenson was seen in pads and a practice jersey on Thursday.
items.impact: Stevenson was listed as a limited participant in practice to begin the week on Wednesday. It appears he'll be getting in another practice on Thursday.
items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) in pads in practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase was wearing pads during practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Chase remains in concussion protocol, but it is a step in the right direction for him. He will need to be monitored in practice again on Friday.
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tee Higgins was not seen practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Higgins was not in uniform in practice on Thursday. It gives him back-to-back missed practices. He'll likely have to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance of playing on Sunday.
items.title: Tee Higgins (adductor/neck) not seen practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Malik Nabers resumed practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Nabers was back on the field after missing practice on Wednesday. He remains on track to be good to go on Sunday.
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) returns to practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell was not seen at the start of practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Mitchell continues to trend towards missing another game on Sunday. He'll need to be monitored in practice on Friday to make sure.
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) not seen practicing Thursday
